correctness.rationale: Facet distances and permutation symmetrization prove sharp radius. For n=4, active degree equalities force opposite-edge equal weights a,b,c, cube section within sum3/2 yields a regular hexagon with radius2h and area6sqrt3 h^2. For n=5, tight degree constraints plus coordinate clearance give x=ell5+kappa*y for y in K5 fractional degree-one matching polytope; all remaining eroded size2/3 facets strictly redundant. Standard half-integral vertex theorem yields exactly ten triangle+edge and twelve Hamiltonian 5-cycle vertices; contact counts follow zero y coordinates. For n>=6 coordinate inequalities force unique uniform center. Independently reconstructed all 22 K5 candidates, checked eroded facets and exact distance comparisons n4..1000.
